body.x: Seiki (www.seiki.com), a leading brand in the emerging 4K Ultra HD display market, announced its entry into the desktop monitor segment with a 32- and 40-inch 4K Ultra HD displays, at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Seiki's 4K Ultra HD desktop display models SM32UNP and SM40UNP feature video resolution up to 3840 x 2160 and 176 degrees viewing angle via Super MVA panel technology. The Seiki Pro desktop display includes two HDMI 1.4 and two DP 1.2 connections capable of 4K Ultra HD resolutions. All four connections may be used simultaneously via Picture-by-Picture mode that displays four Full HD screens on one 4K display.
